# Ground truth: Novus Flow.EDO implementation

**Status:** internal static audit of the checkout on 2026-09-28.
**Scope:** Vue frontend routes, Express server composition, Prisma/R2 persistence, crypto, converter and environment reads. This document describes implemented behavior, not a compliance or legal certification.

## Executable shape

The application is a Vue/Vite browser client plus an Express API started through `tsx server/index.ts`.

| Surface | Actual implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Browser UI | Vue 3, Vue Router, Pinia and client-side signing services |
| API | Express 5 on `PORT`, default `3001` |
| Persistence | Prisma 7 with MariaDB adapter; `DATABASE_URL` fallback is `mysql://novus:novus123@localhost:3306/novus_edo` |
| Object storage | Cloudflare R2 through AWS S3 SDK, with presigned upload/download URLs |
| Mail | Resend plus Vue Email rendering |
| Converter | Independent HTTP service on `127.0.0.1:4174`, spawning LibreOffice (`SOFFICE_PATH` or `soffice`) |
| Browser signing | Document private keys remain browser-side according to the implemented client architecture; server persists signature artifacts and metadata |

`server/index.ts` loads dotenv, rejects missing/sentinel `JWT_SECRET` only when `NODE_ENV=production`, installs CORS with `CORS_ORIGIN` or `*`, mounts routes, and serves `dist/` in production.

## Browser routes

| Route | Auth requirement | Implemented view/meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/`, `/about`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/login`, `/register` | No | Public, legal and identity screens |
| `/dashboard` | Yes | Currently reuses `Inbox.vue` |
| `/documents`, `/documents/new`, `/documents/:id` | Yes | Document list, creation and detail workflow |
| `/contacts`, `/archive`, `/settings` | Yes | Address book, archive and settings |
| `/features`, `/pricing` | No | Redirect to `/` |

The navigation guard fetches the current user when a token exists and redirects unauthenticated protected navigation to `/login` (`src/router/index.ts`).

## Express API catalogue

All paths below have the `/api` prefix shown in the first column.

| Prefix | Operations | Authentication | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/health` | `GET` | No | Basic process health response |
| `/proxy` | `POST` | No | Binary proxy for EUSign CMP/TSP/OCSP traffic |
| `/auth` | `POST /register`, `POST /login`, `GET /verify-email`, `GET /me` | `/me` requires bearer token | Email/password and KEP/TIN login, registration and verification |
| `/users` | `PUT /me`, `PUT /me/password` | Bearer token | Update profile/email and set/change password |
| `/organizations` | `GET /`, `POST /`, `GET /:id/members`, `POST /:id/members` | Bearer token | Organization membership and member management |
| `/documents` | `POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /tasks`, `POST /:id/sign`, `GET /:id/archive`, `GET /:id/download` | Bearer token | Legacy local-upload document workflow |
| `/v2/documents` | `GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /presigned-url`, `POST /`, `POST /:id/sign`, `DELETE /:id`, `POST /:id/cancel`, `GET /:id/archive` | Bearer token | DocumentPackage workflow with R2 storage and routing participants |
| `/public` | `POST /store-verification`, `GET /verify/:id`, `GET /verify/:id/protocol` | Store endpoint optionally accepts bearer token; reads are public | Public signature verification and protocol download |
| `/settings/document-types` | `GET`, `POST`, `POST /:id/toggle` | Bearer token | Global/workspace document type registry |

The API has no checked-in OpenAPI document. The router and these source files are the current HTTP contract.

## Data and object-storage behavior

There are two independent document persistence paths:

1. Legacy `/api/documents` uses Multer `uploads/` and stores local paths in the database. Original download reads that filesystem path; archive creation streams from this local state.
2. `/api/v2/documents` stores package metadata in Prisma and uses R2 object keys. It issues a five-minute presigned upload URL and uploads signatures/PAdES files to R2 after Multer receives them locally.

Public verification stores anonymous objects under `unclaimed/<RNOKPP>/<document UUID>/...`; authenticated submission uses `individuals/<user ID>/documents/<verification ID>/...`. It creates or reuses a fixed system account for anonymous persisted packages. R2 writes request `AES256` server-side encryption.

## Environment registry

| Variable | Type/default | Where used | Startup/feature criticality |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NODE_ENV` | string; production activates JWT enforcement and static serving | `server/index.ts` | Startup boundary |
| `PORT` | integer/string; `3001` | `server/index.ts` | Startup boundary |
| `DATABASE_URL` | MariaDB URL; insecure local fallback shown above | `server/db.ts` | Feature-critical for all persistence |
| `JWT_SECRET` | secret; production must differ from the sentinel | `server/index.ts`, `server/middleware/auth.ts` | Security-critical |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` | 64-hex-char secret; random process fallback | `server/utils/crypto.ts` | Security and data-read critical |
| `BLIND_INDEX_SECRET` | secret; random process fallback | `server/utils/crypto.ts` | Search/index continuity critical |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | origin string; `*` | `server/index.ts` | Security boundary |
| `R2_ACCOUNT_ID`, `R2_ENDPOINT`, `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `R2_BUCKET_NAME`, `R2_PRESIGNED_EXPIRES_IN` | R2 endpoint/credentials; expiration `900` seconds | `server/storageService.ts` | Feature-critical for v2/public objects |
| `RESEND_API_KEY`, `APP_URL` | mail secret and URL; `APP_URL` defaults to `http://localhost:5173` in EDO mail service | `server/emailService.ts` | Feature-critical for email delivery/links |
| `SOFFICE_PATH` | executable name/path; `soffice` | `server/converter.mjs` | Feature-critical only for conversion service |
| `REDIS_HOST`, `REDIS_PORT` | service-local environment reads | worker/queue code paths | Feature-critical only where queue worker is started |

No checked-in `.env.example` or `.env.sample` was found. The README mentions only part of this list and omits `ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `BLIND_INDEX_SECRET`, `NODE_ENV`, `PORT`, `R2_ACCOUNT_ID`, `R2_PRESIGNED_EXPIRES_IN`, `SOFFICE_PATH` and Redis settings.

## Failure modes and implementation limits

| Situation | Observed behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Missing/changed `ENCRYPTION_KEY` or `BLIND_INDEX_SECRET` | The process generates a new random key/secret. Previously encrypted fields cannot be decrypted and blind-index lookup continuity changes after restart. This must be treated as a production configuration failure, not a safe fallback. |
| Invalid encryption key length | Encrypt/decrypt throws because the parsed hex key is not 32 bytes. |
| Production JWT unset/sentinel | API logs critical error and exits before listening. |
| R2 unavailable | v2/public persistence calls fail and return server errors; temporary Multer files are not guaranteed to be cleaned on every exception path. |
| Email unavailable | Mail functions catch/log failures; primary auth/document flow may still return success. |
| Converter missing LibreOffice | `/api/convert` returns `422`; temporary directory cleanup runs in `finally`. |
| Converter input | Converter accepts one supported office file up to 25 MiB, runs LibreOffice without a shell, and listens only on loopback. |
| Public CMP proxy | The proxy accepts caller-provided target address, normalizes HTTP/HTTPS heuristically and makes an outbound POST without an implemented timeout or strict destination allow-list. It needs a dedicated security review before public exposure. |

## Documentation corrections required

1. Add a real environment template that includes all implemented secrets and state-continuity keys, with placeholders only.
2. Publish a generated OpenAPI contract from the Express route files before claiming a stable public API.
3. Document v1 local `uploads/` and v2 R2 persistence as separate, currently coexisting workflows.
4. Do not describe random crypto-key fallback as production-safe.

# Novus Life — REST API Reference & Integration Guide

> **Version:** 1.0.0-beta Enterprise Edition  
> **Base URL:** `https://novus-life.online/api` (Production) or `http://localhost:3001/api` (Local Dev)  
> **Authentication:** Bearer Token (`Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`)  
> **OpenAPI 3.1 Contract:** Available in [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml) and [openapi.json](openapi.json)

---

## 1. Global Request & Response Standards

### Standard Headers
All authenticated API endpoints require the following headers:
```http
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
```

### Standard Error Response Format
```json
{
  "error": "Short human-readable error description",
  "code": "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
  "details": []
}
```

---

## 2. Health & Diagnostics

### `GET /api/health`
Checks backend process uptime and PostgreSQL connection pool status.

- **Authentication:** None (Public)
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "status": "healthy",
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:00:00.000Z",
  "version": "1.0.0-beta",
  "database": "connected",
  "uptimeSeconds": 86400
}
```

---

## 3. Authentication & Account Management (`/api/auth`)

### `POST /api/auth/register`
Creates a new user account with salted password hashing (`bcryptjs`).

- **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "StrongPassword123!",
  "displayName": "Alex Doe"
}
```
- **Response (`201 Created`):**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "user": {
    "id": "0192e210-67a8-7d31-9f20-b44c20e18d09",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "displayName": "Alex Doe",
    "isVerified": false,
    "createdAt": "2026-10-27T15:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

### `POST /api/auth/login`
Authenticates user credentials and issues a signed JWT token.

- **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "StrongPassword123!"
}
```
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "user": {
    "id": "0192e210-67a8-7d31-9f20-b44c20e18d09",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "displayName": "Alex Doe"
  }
}
```

### `GET /api/auth/me`
Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.

- **Authentication:** Required
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "id": "0192e210-67a8-7d31-9f20-b44c20e18d09",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "displayName": "Alex Doe",
  "familyId": "0192e215-4fa2-7b21-8b10-e75b92f91a14",
  "isVerified": true
}
```

---

## 4. Multi-Tenant Delta Synchronization (`/api/sync`)

The synchronization protocol coordinates state between client IndexedDB (`Dexie.js`) and the master PostgreSQL database.

### `GET /api/sync`
Retrieves modified records across all 12 domain tables since the provided timestamp.

- **Authentication:** Required
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `since` *(string, ISO 8601)*: Timestamp of last successful local sync. Example: `?since=2026-10-27T12:00:00.000Z`.
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "serverTime": "2026-10-27T15:30:00.000Z",
  "addresses": [
    {
      "id": "0192e210-67a8-7d31-9f20-b44c20e18d09",
      "name": "Main Apartment",
      "color": "#6366f1",
      "area": 75.5,
      "residentsCount": 3,
      "valuta": "USD",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-27T14:15:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "services": [],
  "tariffs": [],
  "utilities": [],
  "payments": [],
  "reminders": [],
  "schedules": [],
  "shifts": [],
  "financialAccounts": [],
  "financialTransactions": [],
  "budgetCategories": [],
  "piggyBanks": []
}
```

### `POST /api/sync`
Pushes locally created or modified records to the server with upsert merge.

- **Authentication:** Required
- **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "clientTime": "2026-10-27T15:30:00.000Z",
  "addresses": [ ... ],
  "services": [ ... ],
  "tariffs": [ ... ],
  "utilities": [ ... ],
  "payments": [ ... ],
  "reminders": [ ... ],
  "schedules": [ ... ],
  "shifts": [ ... ],
  "financialAccounts": [ ... ],
  "financialTransactions": [ ... ],
  "budgetCategories": [ ... ],
  "piggyBanks": [ ... ]
}
```
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "syncedAt": "2026-10-27T15:30:01.000Z",
  "rowsUpserted": 42
}
```

---

## 5. Google Drive Encrypted Vault (`/api/drive`)

### `GET /api/drive/status`
Checks if the current user has authorized a personal Google Drive backup vault.

- **Authentication:** Required
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "isConnected": true,
  "lastBackupAt": "2026-10-26T22:00:00.000Z",
  "vaultFileId": "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"
}
```

### `POST /api/drive/backup`
Uploads an encrypted JSON payload into the user's isolated `appDataFolder`.

- **Authentication:** Required
- **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "encryptedData": "U2FsdGVkX19+...",
  "checksum": "a3b2c1..."
}
```
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "uploadedAt": "2026-10-27T15:35:00.000Z"
}
```

---

## 6. AI Assistant Engine (`/api/gemini`)

### `POST /api/gemini/chat`
Provides conversational financial analysis and tariff optimization advice using Google Gemini API.

- **Authentication:** Required
- **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "message": "How can I reduce my electric bill under a 2-tier day/night tariff?",
  "context": {
    "currentTariff": "two_tier",
    "dayRate": 4.32,
    "nightRate": 2.16
  }
}
```
- **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "reply": "Under your two-tier tariff, night electricity is 50% cheaper between 23:00 and 07:00...",
  "suggestedActions": [
    "Schedule water heater timer between 23:00 and 06:00",
    "Run washing machine after 23:00"
  ]
}
```

---

## 7. HTTP Status Codes & Error Handling

| Code | Status | Meaning |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `200` | OK | Request succeeded. |
| `201` | Created | Resource successfully created. |
| `400` | Bad Request | Malformed JSON body or invalid parameter. |
| `401` | Unauthorized | Missing or expired Bearer JWT token. |
| `403` | Forbidden | Insufficient permissions under Row Level Security. |
| `404` | Not Found | Requested entity does not exist. |
| `429` | Too Many Requests | Rate limit exceeded (Max 100 requests / minute). |
| `500` | Internal Server Error | Database failure or unhandled exception. |

---

*For interactive exploration, import [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml) into Swagger Editor or Postman.*

# Novus Life — System Architecture & Engineering Guide > **Version:** 1.0.0-beta Enterprise Edition > **Repository:** `SGC-NOVUS/novus-life` > **Status:** Production-Ready Decoupled Architecture > **Documentation URL:** [https://novus-life.online/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://novus-life.online/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) --- ## 1. Architectural Principles Novus Life is architected as an **offline-first, privacy-by-design, local-first enterprise software platform**. It guarantees full operational capability without constant server connectivity, while offering secure synchronization with self-hosted PostgreSQL or Supabase backends. ```mermaid graph TD subgraph ClientDevice["Client Runtime (Browser / PWA)"] subgraph PresentationLayer["Presentation Layer (Vue 3 + Tailwind v4)"] Router["Vue Router (Guards & Lazy Chunks)"] UI["Design System UI (BaseCard, BaseModal, Forms)"] Views["Domain Views (Utilities, Finances, Schedules, Addresses)"] end subgraph StateLayer["State & Store Management (Pinia)"] Stores["Pinia Domain Stores
(useAddressStore, useFinancesStore, etc.)"] end subgraph EngineLayer["Decoupled Calculation Engine"] UtilCalc["Utility Calculator (24 Tariffs, Benefits)"] FinCalc["Financial Calculator (Loans, Grace, Envelopes)"] PayCalc["Payroll Calculator (Shifts, Taxes, Rotations)"] Facade["Calculation Engine Facade"] end subgraph PersistenceLayer["Local-First Data Layer"] DexieDB[("IndexedDB (Dexie.js v4 - NovusLifeDB_v3)
Master Single Source of Truth")] StorageMgr["Storage Manager & Version Migrations"] end subgraph ClientSync["Client Sync & Device Capabilities"] SyncSvc["Sync Service (Delta Conflict Resolution)"] OCRSvc["OCR Engine (Tesseract.js Web Worker)"] CryptoSvc["AES-256-GCM Encryption Service"] end end subgraph NetworkBoundary["Network / Transport Layer"] HTTPS["REST API (HTTPS / TLS 1.3)"] BearerJWT["Authorization: Bearer "] end subgraph ServerRuntime["Server Runtime (Node.js 26 Current / Express 5)"] API["Express App (CORS, Helmet, Rate Limiter)"] AuthModule["Auth Router (JWT, bcryptjs)"] SyncModule["Sync Router (Bi-directional Delta Merge)"] DriveModule["Google Drive Proxy Router"] EmailService["Transactional Email (Resend)"] end subgraph DatabaseLayer["Data Storage & Cloud Tier"] Postgres[("PostgreSQL 18 / Supabase
15 Tables + Row Level Security (RLS)")] GoogleCloud["Google Cloud Storage / Drive API"] end Views --> Stores Stores --> Facade Facade --> UtilCalc Facade --> FinCalc Facade --> PayCalc Stores <--> DexieDB DexieDB <--> SyncSvc SyncSvc --> HTTPS HTTPS --> API API --> AuthModule API --> SyncModule API --> DriveModule API --> EmailService SyncModule <--> Postgres DriveModule <--> GoogleCloud ``` --- ## 2. Monorepo & Workspaces Structure Novus Life uses **npm workspaces** to organize frontend and backend code within a single unified repository. Dependencies are hoisted to the root `/node_modules`, eliminating duplicate library installations and ensuring version synchronization. ### Repository Directory Hierarchy ```text novus-life/ ├── dev/ # Developer tools, changelogs, mock APIs │ ├── CHANGELOG.md # Release history and SemVer notes │ └── mock-api.ts # Isolated mock server for local UI testing ├── docker/ # Docker initialization scripts │ ├── nginx.conf # Nginx production reverse proxy config │ └── postgres-init.sql # PostgreSQL 18 master schema & RLS policies ├── docs/ # Official Comprehensive English Documentation │ ├── README.md # Documentation portal hub │ ├── USER_MANUAL.md # Step-by-step end-user guide │ ├── ARCHITECTURE.md # Technical architecture specification │ ├── FEATURES_AND_MODULES.md # 12 module feature registry │ ├── API_REFERENCE.md # REST API endpoint documentation │ ├── TERMS_OF_SERVICE.md # Legal terms of service │ ├── PRIVACY_POLICY.md # Global privacy policy │ ├── LICENSE.md # Software license agreement │ ├── openapi.yaml # OpenAPI 3.1.0 YAML specification │ └── openapi.json # OpenAPI 3.1.0 JSON specification ├── scripts/ # Build verification & automation scripts │ └── check-semver.sh # Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 validation hook ├── server/ # Backend API Workspace │ ├── Dockerfile # Multi-stage production container build │ ├── package.json # Server dependencies (Express, pg, bcryptjs, etc.) │ ├── tsconfig.json # Server TypeScript configuration │ └── src/ # Server TypeScript source code │ ├── auth.ts # JWT authentication & password hashing │ ├── db.ts # PostgreSQL connection pool with retry logic │ ├── drive.ts # Encrypted Google Drive backup relay │ ├── gemini.ts # AI Assistant endpoints │ ├── index.ts # Express server initialization & CORS │ ├── sync.ts # Master database sync handler │ ├── uuid.ts # UUIDv7 generator │ └── services/ # Service integrations (Resend email) ├── src/ # Frontend Vue 3 PWA Workspace │ ├── assets/ # Global styles, fonts, and assets │ ├── components/ # Global shared Vue components │ ├── core/ # Core business logic & calculators │ │ ├── calculators/ # Decoupled domain calculation modules │ │ │ ├── utility-calculator.ts │ │ │ ├── utility-calculator.test.ts │ │ │ ├── financial-calculator.ts │ │ │ ├── financial-calculator.test.ts │ │ │ ├── payroll-calculator.ts │ │ │ └── payroll-calculator.test.ts │ │ ├── services/ # Database, OCR, crypto, and calculation facade │ │ └── types/ # Unified TypeScript domain definitions │ ├── design-system/ # Design tokens & UI components (BaseCard, BaseModal) │ ├── locales/ # Internationalization (en, ru, uk, pl) │ ├── modules/ # Feature modules (Addresses, Finances, Utilities, etc.) │ ├── router/ # Vue Router configuration │ └── App.vue # Application root component ├── supabase/ # Supabase database migration scripts │ └── schema.sql # Supabase table definitions and RLS policies ├── docker-compose.yml # Production multi-container orchestration ├── package.json # Root package with npm workspaces ├── tsconfig.json # Frontend TypeScript configuration └── vite.config.ts # Vite 6 PWA build configuration ``` --- ## 3. Decoupled Calculation Engine In earlier iterations, all mathematical computations were bundled into a monolithic 1,200-line service. Novus Life has decoupled this logic into three pure, side-effect-free, highly testable domain calculators located in [`src/core/calculators/`](file:///root/novus-life/src/core/calculators/): ### 3.1. Utility Calculator (`utility-calculator.ts`) - **Responsibility:** Meter consumption delta, multi-zone tariff distribution, tiered progressive block brackets, universal benefits (UBD 75% discounts, social caps), distribution/subscription fees, consumption trends, and room-area bill splitting. - **Purity:** Pure deterministic mathematical functions with zero external side effects. - **Test Coverage:** Verified by [`utility-calculator.test.ts`](file:///root/novus-life/src/core/calculators/utility-calculator.test.ts) covering single-rate, multi-tier, UBD discounts, and bill splitting. ### 3.2. Financial Calculator (`financial-calculator.ts`) - **Responsibility:** Standard annuity mortgage amortization, monthly interest calculation, credit card minimum payments, grace period deadlines, 4 Envelopes weekly budgeting allocation, revolving debt trap ("Carousel") detection, and Net Worth/Cash Flow aggregates. - **Test Coverage:** Verified by [`financial-calculator.test.ts`](file:///root/novus-life/src/core/calculators/financial-calculator.test.ts). ### 3.3. Payroll Calculator (`payroll-calculator.ts`) - **Responsibility:** Shift earnings, night premiums ($1.2\times$), two-tier overtime multipliers ($1.5\times / 2.0\times$), holiday multipliers, sick leave seniority coefficients, business trip per diems, cyclic shift rotation mapping (e.g., 2/2, 3/3, 1/3), progressive income tax, and pension/social deductions. - **Test Coverage:** Verified by [`payroll-calculator.test.ts`](file:///root/novus-life/src/core/calculators/payroll-calculator.test.ts). ### 3.4. Backward-Compatible Facade (`calculation-engine.ts`) To prevent breaking existing component imports, [`src/core/services/calculation-engine.ts`](file:///root/novus-life/src/core/services/calculation-engine.ts) acts as a unified facade that re-exports all domain calculators without overhead. --- ## 4. Storage Architecture & Dexie.js Schema Novus Life uses **Dexie.js v4** over HTML5 IndexedDB as its local data store. ### Schema Evolution: `NovusLifeDB_v3` ```typescript // Dexie Version 4 Schema Definition db.version(4).stores({ addresses: '++id, syncId, userId, name, isDefault, createdAt, updatedAt', services: '++id, syncId, addressId, name, typeCode, isArchived, createdAt, updatedAt', tariffs: '++id, syncId, addressId, serviceId, validFrom, validTo, createdAt, updatedAt', utilities: '++id, syncId, addressId, serviceId, year, month, isPaid, [addressId+year+month], createdAt, updatedAt', payments: '++id, syncId, addressId, date, isDeleted, createdAt, updatedAt', reminders: '++id, syncId, addressId, dueDate, isCompleted, createdAt, updatedAt', schedules: '++id, syncId, userId, scheduleType, createdAt, updatedAt', shifts: '++id, syncId, scheduleId, date, shiftType, isConfirmed, [scheduleId+date], createdAt, updatedAt', financialAccounts: '++id, syncId, userId, name, accountCategory, balance, isHidden, createdAt, updatedAt', financialTransactions: '++id, syncId, userId, accountId, date, type, category, isDeleted, createdAt, updatedAt', budgetCategories: '++id, syncId, userId, name, isArchived, createdAt, updatedAt', piggyBanks: '++id, syncId, userId, name, targetDate, isCompleted, createdAt, updatedAt', familyMembers: '++id, syncId, userId, role, createdAt, updatedAt', auditLogs: '++id, entityType, entityId, action, timestamp', }); ``` ### Key Technical Decisions: 1. **Unified Identifier Contract (`number | string`):** Local records use Dexie auto-incrementing integers (`++id`) for zero-latency local operations. Cloud and multi-tenant records use `UUIDv7` (`syncId` / `uuidv7`). Pinia stores accept `id: number | string`, mapping transparently across both layers. 2. **IndexedDB Migration of Piggy Banks & Budget Categories:** In version 4, all financial goals (`piggyBanks`) and category limits (`budgetCategories`) were migrated from browser `localStorage` to IndexedDB, guaranteeing multi-device delta synchronization and preventing storage quota issues. --- ## 5. Backend Architecture & Synchronization Protocol The backend is built with **Express 5** running on **Node.js 26**. ### 5.1. Database Engine & Connection Resilience The backend connects to PostgreSQL 18 using a persistent connection pool with exponential backoff retry logic. If the database container is initializing, the server retries up to 10 times before reporting an error, guaranteeing seamless orchestration under Docker Compose. ### 5.2. Bi-Directional Delta Sync Algorithm Synchronization uses a timestamped delta merge strategy: 1. **Client Handshake:** Client requests changes since its last local sync timestamp: `GET /api/sync?since=2026-10-27T12:00:00.000Z` 2. **Server Response:** Server returns all modified records across all 12 domain tables where `updated_at > :since` and `user_id = :userId`. 3. **Client Merge:** Client writes updated records into Dexie.js using `bulkPut()`. 4. **Client Push:** Client packages all locally created or modified records and sends: `POST /api/sync` 5. **Server Upsert:** Server executes `ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ...` for each entity, updating timestamps. ### 5.3. Row Level Security (RLS) Every table in PostgreSQL enforces RLS: ```sql ALTER TABLE addresses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY addresses_user_isolation ON addresses FOR ALL USING (user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)); ``` --- ## 6. Security, Authentication & Cryptography 1. **JWT Verification with Fallback Guard:** In production (`NODE_ENV=production`), the backend validates that `JWT_SECRET` is not empty and differs from development defaults. If misconfigured, the process terminates immediately. 2. **CORS Hardening:** Cross-Origin Resource Sharing is strictly constrained to allowed origin domains configured via `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`. 3. **Application-Level Encryption:** Sensitive property notes, bank card identifiers, and landlord contacts can be encrypted client-side using **AES-256-GCM** via the browser's hardware-accelerated `crypto.subtle` Web Crypto API. 4. **Automated SemVer Verification:** The pre-commit hook [`scripts/check-semver.sh`](file:///root/novus-life/scripts/check-semver.sh) enforces consistency between `package.json`, `src/config/version.ts`, and `dev/CHANGELOG.md`. --- ## 7. Performance & Bundle Optimization - **CSS Modernization:** Integrated **Tailwind CSS v4** engine with Vite for near-instant hot module replacement (HMR). - **Vendor Chunking:** Configured explicit chunk splitting in `vite.config.ts`: - `vendor-vue`: Vue 3, Vue Router, Pinia, Vue I18n. - `vendor-charts`: Chart.js, vue-chartjs. - `vendor-db`: Dexie.js. - `vendor-pdf`: jsPDF, html2canvas, xlsx. - **Service Worker Caching:** Progressive Web App precaches 62 core assets for zero-latency offline loading. --- *For detailed end-user workflows, please consult [USER_MANUAL.md](USER_MANUAL.md).*

# Novus Life — Features & Module Registry

> **Version:** 1.0.0-beta Enterprise Edition  
> **Status:** Production-Ready Decoupled Architecture  
> **Documentation URL:** [https://novus-life.online/docs/FEATURES_AND_MODULES.md](https://novus-life.online/docs/FEATURES_AND_MODULES.md)

---

## Ecosystem Module Overview

Novus Life consists of **12 deeply integrated core modules** designed to provide end-to-end management of personal and family resources, real estate, debts, cash flow, and work earnings.

```mermaid
graph LR
    Addresses["1. Addresses & Real Estate"] --> Services["2. Service Providers"]
    Services --> Tariffs["3. 24 Tariff Models"]
    Tariffs --> Utilities["4. Utilities & Meter OCR"]
    Utilities --> Finances["5. Finances & 4 Envelopes"]
    Finances --> Guard["6. Financial Guard (Debts)"]
    Finances --> Payments["7. Payments & Receipts"]
    Schedules["8. Schedules & Timesheets"] --> Payroll["9. Payroll & Net Salary"]
    Payroll --> Finances
    Utilities --> Analytics["10. Analytics & Trends"]
    Finances --> Analytics
    Reminders["11. Reminders & Subscriptions"]
    Family["12. Family Sharing & Cloud Sync"]
```

---

## 1. Dashboard & Life Overview (`DashboardView.vue`)

The **Dashboard** serves as the command center, synthesizing high-level aggregates from all active modules:
- **Financial Pulse Widget:** Displays live **Net Worth** ($\sum \text{Assets} - \sum \text{Liabilities}$) and monthly **Net Cash Flow** with percentage changes.
- **Aggregated Utility Debt:** Real-time sum of all unpaid utility charges across all properties.
- **Next Shift & Working Time:** Immediate view of tomorrow's shift type, start time, and estimated earnings.
- **Smart Reminders Card:** Highlights impending bill due dates, credit card grace period expiration, and rental contract milestones.
- **Contextual Quick Actions:** One-tap navigation to log a meter reading, enter an expense, or confirm a worked shift.

---

## 2. Property & Real Estate Management (`AddressesView.vue`)

Manages the physical locations and living environments of the user:
- **Property Types:** Apartment, Private House, Suburban Villa, Office, Warehouse, Commercial Facility.
- **Multi-Currency Support:** Each property can specify its own local billing currency (e.g., USD, EUR, UAH, PLN, GBP).
- **Rental Life Cycle Tracking:**
  - Tracks rental contracts, renewal dates, and monthly payment days.
  - Security deposit ledger (`depositHeld`) with return verification.
  - Landlord Contacts Directory (`LandlordContactsModal.vue`): Stores phone, email, registration address, and passport details.
- **Mortgage & Amortization Tracker (`MortgageDetailsModal.vue`):**
  - Original principal, remaining debt, interest rate, monthly annuity, payment day, and lender details.
  - Real-time payoff progress bar.
- **Room-Area Bill Splitting Engine (`BillSplitModal.vue`):**
  - Distributes utility bills across roommates using equal division, room square meters ($m^2$), or custom percentage shares.

---

## 3. Service Catalog & Utility Providers (`ServicesView.vue`)

A registry of all utility and facility providers connected to each property:
- **Service Categories:** Electricity, Cold Water, Hot Water, Natural Gas, Central Heating, Internet/Fiber, Trash Removal, Intercom, Security, Homeowners Association (HOA/Condo fees).
- **Provider Details:** Provider company name, personal subscriber account number, IBAN payment details, hotline phone, and customer support portal.
- **Meter Counter Configurations:** Supports single-counter, dual-counter (e.g., separate Kitchen and Bathroom risers), and virtual non-metered services.

---

## 4. Tariff Calculation Engine (`TariffsView.vue` & `utility-calculator.ts`)

An industrial-grade calculation engine supporting **24 billing patterns**:
1. **Flat Single-Rate:** Volume multiplied by price per unit.
2. **Two-Zone / Day-Night ($T_0 / T_1$):** Peak day hours and 50% discounted night hours (23:00 to 07:00).
3. **Three-Zone ($T_0 / T_1 / T_2$):** Peak, semi-peak, and night commercial/residential rates.
4. **Tiered Progressive Block Rates:** Up to 5 volume tiers with increasing marginal cost per unit.
5. **Square-Meter Maintenance Fees:** Floor area ($m^2$) multiplied by tariff rate (Heating, HOA).
6. **Fixed Monthly Subscriptions:** Flat-rate recurring fee regardless of consumption volume.
7. **Social Quotas & Veteran Benefits:** Universal engine calculating legally mandated discounts (e.g., Combat Veteran UBD 75% reduction within social norms, with standard rates applied to excess).
8. **Subscription & Distribution Add-ons:** Combines volumetric consumption charges with fixed distribution capacity fees.

---

## 5. Utilities Metering & Optical OCR (`UtilitiesView.vue`)

The operational module for capturing monthly meter values:
- **Historical Comparison:** Automatically retrieves the preceding month's final reading to calculate net volume consumed.
- **Tesseract.js Optical Character Recognition (OCR):**
  - Runs 100% locally in a Web Worker using WebAssembly.
  - Scans mechanical counter dials and digital LCD screens from device camera or photo upload without transmitting images to external servers.
- **Torch / Flashlight Control:** Web MediaStream track API integration to illuminate dark electrical panels.
- **Consumption Trend Indicators:** Color-coded badges indicating volume acceleration or reduction compared to the trailing 3-month average.
- **Export Engine:** Formats full payment receipts in PDF or CSV/Excel with mathematical formula breakdowns.

---

## 6. Wealth Management & Financial Accounting (`FinancesView.vue` & `financial-calculator.ts`)

Personal accounting system based on modern financial management standards:
- **Account Types:** Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Cash Wallets, High-Yield Savings, Mortgages, Installment Loans, Crypto.
- **Multi-Currency Cash Flow:** Tracks income, expense, and transfer transactions with automatic currency conversions.
- **Split-Check Transaction Support:** Allows splitting a single transaction across multiple budgetary categories.
- **The "4 Envelopes" Adaptive Budget:**
  - Formula: $\text{Weekly Budget} = \frac{\text{Monthly Income} - (\text{Mandatory Expenses} + \text{Savings Reserve})}{4}$.
  - Dynamically computes weekly available funds and visualizes remaining balances across Envelopes 1 through 4.
- **Target Savings Goals (Piggy Banks):** Goal name, target amount, target date, and visual funding progress bars (`PiggyBankModal.vue`).
- **Financial Trash Bin (`TrashBinModal.vue`):** Soft-delete architecture allowing full reversal and restoration of mistakenly deleted financial operations.

---

## 7. Financial Guard & Debt Analyzer (`FinancialGuardView.vue`)

Proactive algorithmic protection against credit card debt traps:
- **Revolving Carousel Trap Detection:**
  - Analyzes transaction patterns over rolling 45-day intervals.
  - Warns users when debt repayments are immediately followed by re-borrowing $\ge 85\%$ of the repaid amount.
- **Grace Period Countdown Timer:**
  - Calculates interest-free cutoff dates based on card statement cycles (from 1st of month or transaction date).
- **Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio Analyzer:**
  - Computes total monthly debt service divided by gross income to evaluate insolvency risk (Safe $< 35\%$, Moderate $36-49\%$, Danger $> 50\%$).
- **Accelerated Debt Repayment Strategies:**
  - Simulates **Debt Snowball** (lowest balance first) and **Debt Avalanche** (highest interest rate first) timelines.

---

## 8. Payment History & Reconciliation (`PaymentsView.vue`)

Ledger of confirmed utility and debt settlements:
- **Payment Verification:** Records payment date, payment instrument (Card, Cash, Bank Transfer), transaction receipt reference, and confirmation status.
- **Utility Pool Settlement:** 1-click feature to aggregate all accrued utility debts across all properties into a single outgoing payment transaction in the financial ledger.

---

## 9. Reminders & Subscription Watchdog (`RemindersView.vue`)

Proactive notification system for recurring obligations:
- **Recurring Schedules:** Monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, or annual recurrence rules.
- **Weekend Adjustment Rules:** Automatically adjusts due dates falling on weekends to the preceding Friday or following Monday.
- **Subscription Cost Aggregator:** Summarizes annual commitments to digital services (streaming, software, insurance, memberships).

---

## 10. Work Schedules, Timesheets & Payroll (`SchedulesView.vue` & `payroll-calculator.ts`)

Specialized tools for shift workers, freelancers, and hourly professionals:
- **Cyclic Shift Rotation Builder:**
  - Supports 2/2, 3/3, 1/3, 4/2, and custom rotation patterns.
  - Maps future shift calendars across months based on a designated first working day.
- **Shift Types:** Day Shift, Night Shift, 24-Hour Duty, Post-Night Rest, Off Day, Sick Leave, Vacation, Business Trip, Substitution.
- **Automated Surcharges & Multipliers:**
  - Night work premium ($1.2\times$ base hourly rate between 22:00 and 06:00).
  - Two-tier overtime ($1.5\times$ for first 2 hours, $2.0\times$ for consecutive hours).
  - Public holiday double rate ($2.0\times$).
- **Sick Pay by Career Seniority:** Adjusts sick pay percentages ($60\%, 80\%, 100\%$) based on years of insured employment.
- **Gross-to-Net Payroll Computation:**
  - Deducts personal income tax (PIT), social/pension contributions, and advances paid.
  - Adds housing and transport allowances and business trip daily subsistence (Per Diem).
- **One-Click Sync to Finances:** Automatically posts net calculated earnings into the chosen financial account.

---

## 11. Visual Analytics & Charts (`AnalyticsView.vue`)

Visual reporting powered by **Chart.js**:
- **Utility Resource Consumption Over Time:** Multi-year line and bar charts tracking electricity, water, and gas usage.
- **Financial Cash Flow Breakdown:** Monthly income vs. expense stacked bar charts.
- **Expense Category Doughnut Chart:** Interactive breakdown of spending by category with percentage distribution.
- **Working Hours & Productivity:** Monthly trends comparing normal hours, overtime, and night shifts.

---

## 12. Family Sharing & System Settings (`SettingsView.vue`)

System-wide administrative and security management:
- **Theme Engine:** Instant switching between Dark Mode (deep indigo-slate background) and Light Mode with system preference detection.
- **Internationalization (i18n):** Real-time language switching between English, Ukrainian, Polish, and Russian.
- **Database Backup & Restore:** Export complete database as JSON; import and validate external backups.
- **Family Multi-Tenancy:** Manage family members, role assignments, and shared property permissions.
- **Cloud Synchronization Settings:** Configure self-hosted PostgreSQL endpoint or Google Drive OAuth 2.0 encrypted vault.

---

*For technical architecture details, refer to [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md). For end-user instructions, see [USER_MANUAL.md](USER_MANUAL.md).*

# Novus Life — Global Privacy Policy

> **Effective Date:** October 27, 2026  
> **Document Version:** 2.2 Enterprise Global Edition  
> **Jurisdictional Compliance:** General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR 2016/679), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), UK Data Protection Act, ISO/IEC 27001  
> **Google API Status:** Strict Adherence to [Google API Services User Data Policy (Limited Use)](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy)  
> **Documentation URL:** [https://novus-life.online/docs/PRIVACY_POLICY.md](https://novus-life.online/docs/PRIVACY_POLICY.md)

---

## 1. Preamble & Fundamental Principles

1.1. The **Novus Life** application suite (including the web application, progressive web app clients, native desktop/mobile wrappers, and backend synchronization services, developed by **SGC-NOVUS**) operates under the uncompromising paradigm of **Privacy by Design** and **Zero-Knowledge Architecture**.

1.2. We operate under a straightforward tenet: **Your personal life, real estate assets, utility meter readings, income, debts, work shifts, and banking transactions belong exclusively to you.** 

1.3. Neither the developers, server administrators, nor external third parties possess the technical, architectural, or cryptographic capability to inspect, sell, monetize, or profile the contents of your records.

---

## 2. Zero-Knowledge Encryption & Security Architecture

### 2.1. Client-Side Cryptographic Execution
All processing of sensitive financial numbers, utility meters, and personal notes occurs directly within the trusted execution sandbox of your client browser or operating system:
- **Encryption Algorithm:** Symmetric block cipher **AES-256-GCM** (Advanced Encryption Standard with a 256-bit key in Galois/Counter Mode for authenticated encryption).
- **Key Derivation:** Master encryption keys are generated directly from your master passphrase using **PBKDF2** (Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2) with **HMAC-SHA-256** and a minimum of **100,000 computational rounds**.
- **Hardware Acceleration:** All cryptographic transformations run locally via the standardized W3C Web Cryptography API (`window.crypto.subtle`), ensuring native hardware execution speeds and memory protection.

### 2.2. On-Device Optical Recognition (OCR)
When scanning utility meters with your device camera:
- Recognition is executed entirely in an isolated browser **Web Worker** via **Tesseract.js** (WebAssembly).
- **No photos, video streams, or image metadata are ever uploaded to cloud servers or remote AI services for processing.**

---

## 3. Data Categories: What We Collect vs. What We Never Collect

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph LocalOnly["Stored Exclusively on Your Device (IndexedDB)"]
        Meters["Meter Readings & OCR Scans"]
        Finances["Financial Accounts, Balances, Debt Details"]
        Shifts["Working Hours, Overtime, Salary Calculations"]
        Notes["Landlord Contacts, Leases, Property Notes"]
    end

    subgraph ServerSync["Server Tier (When Cloud Sync is Enabled)"]
        AuthData["Email + Salted bcrypt Password Hash"]
        SyncPayload["Opaque Sync Delta Records (Protected by RLS)"]
        Timestamps["Row updatedAt Timestamps (For Delta Merge)"]
    end

    subgraph Prohibited["NEVER Collected or Monitored"]
        NoTracking["NO Analytics Tracking or Ad Trackers"]
        NoBanking["NO Credit Card CVV, PINs, or Bank Credentials"]
        NoSelling["NO Sale, Rental, or Brokerage of User Data"]
        NoAI["NO LLM Model Training on Private Data"]
    end
```

### 3.1. Information Processed Locally on Your Device (IndexedDB)
- Property names, floor area ($m^2$), resident counts.
- Utility service providers, account numbers, and tariff parameters.
- Meter reading histories and consumption delta records.
- Financial transactions, account categories, credit card limits, and grace period rules.
- Work shift rosters, hours worked, hourly rates, and tax deduction configurations.

### 3.2. Information Processed on the Server (Only if You Enable Cloud Sync)
- **Account Identity:** Email address and cryptographically salted password hash (`bcryptjs`).
- **Encrypted Synchronization Payloads:** Data rows synchronized via REST API with strict database **Row Level Security (RLS)** ensuring multi-tenant isolation.
- **Session Tokens:** Cryptographically signed JSON Web Tokens (JWT) used exclusively to authorize API requests.

### 3.3. Information We NEVER Collect
- We **never** collect, request, or store credit card CVV/CVC codes or banking PINs.
- We **never** inject third-party advertising tracking scripts, telemetry pixels, or data broker beacons (e.g., Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Mixpanel).
- We **never** use your personal budgets, utility bills, or work records to train public AI/LLM models.

---

## 4. Google API Services & Google Drive Policy (Limited Use)

Novus Life provides an optional cloud backup integration with **Google Drive**.

4.1. **Strictly Limited Scope:**  
Novus Life requests access only to the restricted `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata` scope. This scope allows the application to create, read, and update files **only within a hidden, isolated application folder (`appDataFolder`)** specifically created for Novus Life.

4.2. **No Access to General Drive Files:**  
The application **cannot** read, modify, view, or delete your personal documents, photos, spreadsheets, or folders stored elsewhere in your Google Drive.

4.3. **Compliance with Google User Data Policy:**  
Novus Life's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs adheres to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the **Limited Use requirements**:
- We do not allow humans to read user data.
- We do not transfer data to third parties.
- We do not use Google user data for serving advertisements.
- Backup files uploaded to Google Drive are encrypted client-side before transmission.

---

## 5. Legal Bases for Data Processing (GDPR Compliance)

Under Article 6 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we process your information under the following legal bases:
1. **Performance of a Contract:** Processing your login credentials and sync payloads is necessary to provide the multi-device synchronization service you requested.
2. **Legitimate Interests:** Maintaining server security, mitigating brute-force attacks, and enforcing rate limiting.
3. **Explicit Consent:** You provide explicit consent when authorizing Google Drive backups or inviting family members to your shared workspace.

---

## 6. Your Data Rights & Sovereignty

Regardless of your geographic location, Novus Life guarantees you the full protections afforded under GDPR and CCPA/CPRA:

- **Right to Access & Data Portability (Article 15 & 20 GDPR):**  
  You can export your entire database at any time in machine-readable JSON format via **Settings $\rightarrow$ Export Database**.
- **Right to Rectification (Article 16 GDPR):**  
  You can update, edit, or overwrite any record across all modules directly in the interface.
- **Right to Erasure / "Right to be Forgotten" (Article 17 GDPR):**  
  You can wipe all data on your local device with one click (**Settings $\rightarrow$ Purge Local Storage**). If you maintain an account on our synchronization server, you can request immediate, permanent deletion of your server database records.
- **Right to Restrict Processing:**  
  You can use Novus Life entirely in offline guest mode without ever transmitting data over the internet.

---

## 7. Data Retention & Backups

7.1. **Local Device Data:** Retained in your browser's IndexedDB until you manually clear it, reset your device, or purge application storage.

7.2. **Cloud Sync Records:** Stored in PostgreSQL with Row Level Security for as long as your account remains active. If an account is inactive for more than twelve (12) consecutive months, associated synchronization records may be permanently purged following email notification.

---

## 8. Protection of Children's Privacy (COPPA)

Novus Life is not directed toward children under the age of 13 (or 16 within the European Economic Area). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information without parental consent, please contact us for immediate deletion.

---

## 9. Updates to this Privacy Policy

We may periodically revise this Privacy Policy to reflect technical improvements or legal requirements. Material updates will be highlighted on our documentation portal and accompanied by an updated effective date.

---

## 10. Data Protection Officer & Privacy Contacts

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy, wish to exercise your data rights, or report a security concern:
- **Data Protection Officer (DPO):** `privacy@novus-life.online`
- **Security Incident Response:** `security@novus-life.online`
- **Project Repository:** [https://github.com/SGC-NOVUS/novus-life](https://github.com/SGC-NOVUS/novus-life)

---

*End of Global Privacy Policy.*

# Novus Life — Official Documentation Portal > **Version:** 1.0.0-beta > **Ecosystem:** Novus Life (Vue 3 PWA, Express REST API, PostgreSQL, Dexie.js v4) > **Platform Support:** Web, Progressive Web App (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux) > **Documentation URL:** [https://novus-life.online/docs](https://novus-life.online/docs) --- ## Welcome to the Novus Life Documentation Hub **Novus Life** is an enterprise-grade, privacy-centric, **Local-First Progressive Web Application (PWA)** designed for unified personal and family management: - **Property & Resource Accounting:** 24 tariff models, multi-meter setups, social quotas/benefits, and optical meter recognition (OCR). - **Wealth & Debt Engineering:** Multi-currency cash flow, grace period tracking, 4 Envelopes adaptive budgeting, and automated "Carousel" debt trap detection. - **Roster & Payroll Timesheets:** Shift scheduling (rotations 2/2, 3/3, 1/3, night hours), overtime multipliers, sick leave seniority tiers, and net salary calculations. - **Local-First & Multi-Tenant Sync:** Offline-first IndexedDB persistence with cloud backup to self-hosted PostgreSQL or Supabase with Row Level Security (RLS). --- ## 📚 Documentation Index | Document | Description | Target Audience | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | [**User Manual & Guide**](USER_MANUAL.md) | **Comprehensive End-User Guide from A to Z:** Step-by-step instructions, property setup, tariff configuration, OCR meter scanning, wealth management, 4 Envelopes method, timesheets, tips, shortcuts, and troubleshooting. | Users & Administrators | | [**Architecture & Engineering**](ARCHITECTURE.md) | **Technical Deep Dive:** Monorepo architecture, Dexie v4 IndexedDB schemas, decoupled calculation engines, REST API synchronization protocol, and security models. | Developers & Architects | | [**Feature & Module Registry**](FEATURES_AND_MODULES.md) | **Complete Ecosystem Inventory:** Mathematical formulas, data models, state flows, and technical parameters across all 12 modules. | Analysts & Engineers | | [**API Reference**](API_REFERENCE.md) | **REST API Developer Reference:** Endpoints, request/response JSON schemas, JWT authentication, error handling, and sync specifications. | Backend & API Consumers | | [**OpenAPI Specification**](openapi.yaml) | **OpenAPI 3.1.0 Contract:** Interactive Swagger/Postman compatible schema for backend validation and client generation. | API Integrators | | [**Terms of Service**](TERMS_OF_SERVICE.md) | **User Agreement & Rules of Conduct:** Legal terms, acceptable use policy, warranty disclaimers, and service availability guidelines. | Legal & All Users | | [**Privacy Policy**](PRIVACY_POLICY.md) | **Global Data Protection & Privacy:** GDPR, CCPA, local-first zero-trust principles, cryptographic controls, and user rights. | Compliance & Users | | [**License Agreement**](LICENSE.md) | **Software License:** MIT Open Core License with Enterprise commercial deployment terms. | Open Source & Enterprise | --- ## 🚀 Quick Start Guide ### Prerequisites - **Node.js:** v26.x (Recommended) or v24.x LTS - **Package Manager:** `npm` v10+ (Workspaces enabled) - **Container Runtime:** Docker 24+ & Docker Compose (Optional for full-stack deployment) ### 1. Installation & Monorepo Setup Novus Life utilizes modern **npm workspaces** to manage both the Vue 3 frontend and Express backend without duplicate dependencies: ```bash # Clone the repository git clone git@github.com:SGC-NOVUS/novus-life.git cd novus-life # Install all monorepo dependencies (hoisted to root node_modules) npm install ``` ### 2. Running in Development Mode ```bash # Start the Vite Frontend Development Server (Port 3000) npm run dev # Start the Express Backend API (Port 3001) npm run --prefix server start ``` ### 3. Running Automated Tests ```bash # Execute the Vitest calculation test suite (Utility, Financial, Payroll) npm test ``` ### 4. Building for Production ```bash # Build the Frontend PWA with strict TypeScript verification npm run build # Build the Backend API npm run --prefix server build ``` ### 5. Full-Stack Docker Deployment ```bash # Spin up PostgreSQL 18, Backend API, and Nginx Frontend in one command docker compose up -d --build ``` --- ## 🏛️ Architecture Overview ```mermaid graph TD subgraph Client["Client Browser / Native PWA (Offline-First)"] UI["Vue 3 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Pinia"] IndexedDB[("Dexie.js v4 (NovusLifeDB_v3)
Local-First Master")] CalcEngines["Decoupled Calculation Engines
(Utility, Financial, Payroll)"] SyncWorker["Sync Service
(Bi-Directional Delta Sync)"] end subgraph Backend["Self-Hosted Backend / Cloud"] API["Node.js / Express API (Port 3001)"] Postgres[("PostgreSQL 18 / Supabase
(15 Domain Tables + RLS)")] GoogleOAuth["Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 / Drive"] ResendMail["Transactional Email (Resend)"] end UI <--> IndexedDB UI --> CalcEngines IndexedDB <--> SyncWorker SyncWorker <-->|REST API + JWT| API API <--> Postgres API --> GoogleOAuth API --> ResendMail ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Data Sovereignty Highlights - **Zero-Trust Storage:** All sensitive computations occur locally on the user's device. # Security Architecture & Cryptographic Model

**Project**: Novus Life  
**Maintainer**: SGC-NOVUS (System Generation Core)  
**Security Level**: Zero-Knowledge Client-Side Encryption (E2EE)

---

## 1. Threat Model & Design Principles

Novus Life is engineered under the assumption that central servers and communication channels can be subjected to inspection or unauthorized compromise. To guarantee user privacy under any conditions, the application implements a strict **Zero-Knowledge Architecture**:

1. **Client-Side Encryption Only**: Plaintext meter readings, property titles, financial amounts, and personal comments never reach server memory or disk storage.
2. **No Server Master Keys**: The central PostgreSQL database and API servers hold zero private keys or secret material capable of reversing client ciphertexts.
3. **Hardware-Accelerated Cryptography**: All cryptographic primitives rely on the standard W3C **Web Crypto API** (`crypto.subtle`).

---

## 2. Cryptographic Primitives & Specifications

### 2.1 Symmetric Encryption (AES-GCM-256)
- **Algorithm**: `AES-GCM` (Advanced Encryption Standard in Galois/Counter Mode).
- **Key Length**: 256 bits.
- **Initialization Vector (IV)**: 96-bit cryptographically secure pseudorandom value generated per operation via `crypto.getRandomValues()`.
- **Integrity Tag**: 128-bit authentication tag embedded directly into the GCM stream to detect tampering.

### 2.2 Key Derivation (PBKDF2)
- **Algorithm**: `PBKDF2` (Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2).
- **PRF**: `HMAC-SHA-256`.
- **Work Factor**: 100,000 iterations.
- **Salt**: Isolated project-specific entropy salt (`novus_life_zero_knowledge_salt_2026`).

---

## 3. Storage Security & OS Eviction Defense

### 3.1 Persistent Storage API
By default, web browsers treat IndexedDB as temporary storage subject to silent eviction under operating system storage pressure. Novus Life explicitly invokes:
```typescript
await navigator.storage.persist();
```
This transitions the storage sandbox to **persisted mode**, ensuring the database is exempted from automated OS purge mechanisms.

### 3.2 WebAPK Sandbox Isolation
On Android devices, the WebAPK packaging architecture assigns the application its own unique Linux User ID (UID), providing process isolation and restricting inter-process communication (IPC) to explicit system permissions.

---

## 4. Google Drive Integration Security

When backing up to Google Drive:
- Scope requested: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata`.
- The application is sandboxed inside the hidden `appDataFolder`.
- The snapshot payload (`novus_life_vault.json.enc`) is encrypted with client-side AES-256-GCM before transmission. Google Drive servers receive only encrypted binary data.

   * 7.5. One-Click Earnings Synchronization to Budget
8. [Data Sync, Backups & Privacy](#8-data-sync-backups--privacy)
   * 8.1. Local-First Offline Operation
   * 8.2. Cloud Synchronization (Self-Hosted PostgreSQL & Supabase)
   * 8.3. Google Drive Encrypted Vault Backup
9. [Power User Tips & Shortcuts](#9-power-user-tips--shortcuts)
10. [Troubleshooting & FAQ](#10-troubleshooting--faq)

---

## 1. Introduction & Core Philosophy

Novus Life is built on three uncompromised engineering pillars:
1. **Local-First Architecture:** Your device is the single source of truth. The application works 100% offline via modern IndexedDB (`Dexie.js v4`). You never lose access to your data during network outages.
2. **Absolute Data Privacy:** Your personal financial records, utility bills, and work hours belong exclusively to you. All sensitive calculations execute locally in your browser.
3. **Enterprise Precision:** Whether calculating tiered block electricity tariffs, mortgage amortization, or complex multi-shift payroll with progressive taxation, mathematical accuracy is strictly guaranteed.

---

## 2. Installation, PWA Setup & Offline Mode

Novus Life is distributed as a **Progressive Web App (PWA)**, meaning you do not need an app store account to install it. It provides native speed, home-screen icons, offline caching, and push notifications.

### 📱 Installing on iOS (iPhone & iPad)
1. Open **Safari** and navigate to your Novus Life instance (e.g., `https://novus-life.online`).
2. Tap the **Share** button (the square with an arrow pointing up) in the bottom toolbar.
3. Scroll down and select **"Add to Home Screen"**.
4. Confirm the application title and tap **"Add"**. Novus Life will launch as a standalone application without Safari browser chrome.

### 🤖 Installing on Android (Chrome, Brave, Samsung Internet)
1. Open **Chrome** and navigate to your Novus Life instance.
2. A banner reading **"Install Novus Life"** will automatically appear at the bottom. Tap **Install**.
3. If the banner does not appear, tap the three-dot menu `⋮` in the upper-right corner and select **"Install app"** or **"Add to Home screen"**.

### 💻 Installing on Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux)
1. In Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Brave, look at the right side of the address bar.
2. Click the **Install** icon (a monitor with a down arrow).
3. The app will launch in an isolated native desktop window and register in your operating system application launcher.

> [!TIP]
> **Offline Readiness:** Once loaded for the first time, all application assets, stylesheets, scripts, and language bundles are stored in the browser's Service Worker cache (`Workbox`). You can turn on Airplane Mode and use 100% of the application without an internet connection.

---

## 3. Property & Address Management

The **Addresses** module is the central container for your living spaces, commercial offices, rental apartments, and vacation homes.

### 3.1. Adding and Configuring Properties
1. Navigate to **Addresses** from the sidebar or bottom navigation.
2. Click **"+ Add Object"**.
3. Enter property parameters:
   - **Name:** e.g., "Main Apartment", "Suburban House", "Studio on Central Ave".
   - **Type:** Apartment, Private House, Office, Warehouse, Commercial.
   - **Primary Currency:** Select the local billing currency (e.g., USD, EUR, UAH, PLN).
   - **Total Area ($m^2$):** Used for square-meter heating, maintenance, and bill splitting calculations.
   - **Residents Count:** Used for per-capita garbage disposal and water standards.
   - **Accent Color:** Personalize cards with a custom color badge for quick visual recognition.

### 3.2. Rental Properties & Landlord Directory
If you rent an apartment or lease out property:
- Toggle **"Rental Property"** in the property settings.
- Fill in:
  - **Contract End Date:** Automatic reminders will notify you before the lease renewal deadline.
  - **Payment Day:** Monthly due date for rent transfer.
  - **Security Deposit:** Track the amount held by the landlord to guarantee return upon lease termination.
  - **Landlord Contact Details:** Full Name, Phone, Email, Passport/ID, and Registration Address for instant calling and emailing.

### 3.3. Mortgage Tracking & Loan Amortization
For mortgaged properties, activate the **Mortgage** switch:
- Specify the **Original Principal**, **Annual Interest Rate (%)**, **Term (Months)**, and **Lender Name**.
- Novus Life calculates:
  - **Monthly Annuity Payment:** Monthly breakdown of principal and interest.
  - **Principal Paid vs. Remaining Balance:** Visual progress bar tracking loan repayment.
  - **Annual Property Insurance Cost:** Automatically added to total ownership cost calculations.

### 3.4. Multi-Tenant Bill Splitting
When sharing an apartment with roommates or family members:
1. Open the property settings and enable **"Bill Splitting"**.
2. Select the distribution method:
   - **Equal Shares:** Splits total expenses equally among all roommates ($1/N$).
   - **By Room Area ($m^2$):** Each resident pays proportional to their bedroom size, while common areas are shared equally.
   - **Custom Percentages (%):** Manually assign customized percentages per resident.
3. Add participant names, phone numbers, and room areas. Novus Life will calculate each person's exact share on every utility bill.

---

## 4. Utility Resource Metering (Utilities Engine)

The **Utilities** module is powered by an industrial-grade calculation engine supporting **24 tariff models**, multi-meter configurations, and optical recognition.

### 4.1. Supported Tariff Models
Novus Life supports all standard utility billing methods worldwide:
- **Flat Single Rate:** Standard volume multiplied by a fixed rate per unit (e.g., $100\text{ kWh} \times \$0.15$).
- **Two-Zone / Day-Night:** Separate meters or split time intervals (Day rate $T_0$ + Night discount rate $T_1$, typically 50% from 23:00 to 07:00).
- **Three-Zone (Peak / Semi-Peak / Night):** Differentiated commercial and residential power tariffs.
- **Tiered Block Tariffs:** Progressive price brackets (e.g., First $100\text{ kWh}$ at $\$0.10$, volume between $101-250\text{ kWh}$ at $\$0.18$, volume above $250\text{ kWh}$ at $\$0.30$).
- **Fixed Monthly Subscription / Area-Based:** Maintenance fees based on floor area ($m^2$) or fixed service fees (Internet, security, elevator).
- **Two-Meter Configurations (Kitchen & Bathroom):** Separate readings for cold/hot water risers with unified calculation.

### 4.2. Entering Readings & Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
1. Open the **Utilities** tab and select the current billing month.
2. Click **"Enter Reading"** on the target service.
3. You have three ways to enter readings:
   - **Manual Input:** Type the new meter numbers. Consumption is calculated automatically against the previous month's final reading.
   - **Camera OCR Recognition:** Tap **"Scan with Camera"**. Point your smartphone camera at the mechanical or digital meter display. The embedded `Tesseract.js` engine extracts numerical digits directly in the browser without uploading photos to external servers.
   - **Flashlight / Torch Toggle:** If inspecting a dark electrical panel or basement, tap the **Flashlight** button to illuminate the meter.

### 4.3. Social Norms, Benefits & Subsidies
Novus Life features a universal social quota and benefit engine:
- **Combat Veteran / Service Discount (UBD 75%):** Applies a legally mandated 75% discount to consumption within normative limits.
- **Large Family / Low-Income Subsidy:** Supports fixed monetary subsidies or percentage reductions.
- **Normative Quota Caps:** Subsidized rates apply up to the normative threshold (e.g., $70\text{ kWh}$ per family member), and standard rates apply to excess volume.

### 4.4. Subscription & Distribution Fees
Certain utilities (e.g., natural gas transmission or district heating maintenance) charge a separate fixed monthly capacity fee regardless of consumption:
- Enter the **Subscription Fee** in the tariff configuration.
- The breakdown will show:
  $$\text{Total Due} = (\text{Volume} \times \text{Rate}) + \text{Distribution Fee} - \text{Benefits}$$

### 4.5. Exporting Statements (PDF & Excel)
- Click **"Export PDF"** to generate an official payment statement with barcodes, account numbers, and detailed formula breakdowns.
- Click **"Export Excel"** to download complete historical time-series datasets (`.xlsx` or `.csv`) for personal archives or tax reporting.

---

## 5. Wealth Management & Financial Engineering

The **Finances** module implements double-entry personal accounting inspired by professional wealth management standards.

### 5.1. Accounts Architecture: Net Worth & Cash Flow
Novus Life classifies all accounts into two macroeconomic categories:
- **Assets:** Cash in wallet, checking/debit accounts, savings deposits, investment accounts, and cryptocurrency wallets.
- **Liabilities:** Credit card balances, installment loans, personal debts, and mortgages.

$$\text{Net Worth} = \sum \text{Assets} - \sum \text{Liabilities}$$
$$\text{Net Cash Flow} = \text{Total Monthly Income} - \text{Total Monthly Expenses}$$

### 5.2. Credit Cards, Grace Periods & Minimum Payments
Credit cards require rigorous monitoring to avoid expensive bank penalties:
- **Grace Period (Days):** Enter your card's interest-free term (e.g., 55 or 62 days).
- **Grace Period Trigger:**
  - *From 1st of the month:* Debt incurred in April must be repaid by May 25th.
  - *From transaction date:* Each transaction has an individual countdown timer.
- **Minimum Mandatory Payment:** Configurable as a percentage of total balance (e.g., 5%) plus minimum monetary floor (e.g., $100).
- **Countdown Badges:** The Financial dashboard displays dynamic alerts showing days remaining before interest applies.

### 5.3. Financial Guard: Automated Debt Trap ("Carousel") Detection
Credit card "Carousel" (revolving borrowing from Card B to repay Card A) is the #1 cause of personal insolvency.
- **Detection Algorithm:** If you make a debt repayment into a credit card, but within 45 days spend $\ge 85\%$ of that amount from the same credit limit, Financial Guard flags a **Carousel Warning**:
  > *"Warning: Revolving Debt Carousel detected! You repaid \$5,000 but spent \$4,800 shortly after. Your net debt is not decreasing. Lock this balance with debit funds!"*

### 5.4. Transactions, Split Checks & Reconciliation
- **Quick Logging:** Record expenses and income with category tags (#groceries, #fuel, #entertainment).
- **Split Checks (Multi-Category Receipts):** When shopping at a supermarket or department store, tap **"Split Receipt"** to divide a single \$150 transaction into \$90 Groceries, \$40 Household Goods, and \$20 Clothing.
- **Reconciliation Status:** Mark transactions as *Cleared*, *Reconciled*, or *Void* when checking your physical bank statement.

### 5.5. Soft-Delete Trash Bin & Transaction Recovery
To prevent accidental data loss:
- Deleted transactions are moved to the **Financial Trash Bin** rather than being permanently destroyed.
- The account balance automatically rolls back upon deletion.
- You can restore any deleted record with one click or choose **"Empty Trash"** to purge.

---

## 6. Adaptive Budgeting & Savings Goals

### 6.1. The "4 Envelopes" Weekly Budgeting Method
The 4 Envelopes system removes the stress of detailed daily micro-budgeting:
1. Enter your **Expected Monthly Income**.
2. Subtract **Mandatory Fixed Expenses** (Rent, utilities, loan installments, insurance).
3. Subtract your **Savings Reserve** (e.g., 10% emergency cushion).
4. The remaining funds are automatically split equally into **4 Weekly Envelopes**:
   $$\text{Weekly Envelope Limit} = \frac{\text{Income} - (\text{Mandatory Expenses} + \text{Savings Reserve})}{4}$$
5. As you spend during Week 1, the envelope depletes. Any surplus on Sunday night can be rolled into your **Piggy Bank**!

### 6.2. Two-Tier Category Budgets
Organize expenses into Parent Categories (e.g., "Transportation") and Subcategories ("Fuel", "Parking", "Public Transit", "Repairs") with visual threshold progress bars (Safe $\le 75\%$, Warning $76-90\%$, Overbudget $> 90\%$).

### 6.3. Piggy Banks & Target Savings Goals
- Create targeted savings buckets (e.g., "Emergency Fund", "New Laptop", "Summer Vacation").
- Set a **Target Amount** and **Target Date**.
- Novus Life calculates required monthly contributions and displays visual progress animations.

---

## 7. Work Schedules, Timesheets & Payroll

The **Schedules & Payroll** module is tailored for shift workers, freelancers, medical staff, law enforcement, and hourly professionals.

### 7.1. Work Schedule Builder
Configure complex rotating cycles:
- **Preset Cycles:** 2/2 (2 Day shifts, 2 Off), 3/3, 1/3 (24h on, 72h off), 4/2, or standard 5/2.
- **Custom Pattern Editor:** Define any arbitrary sequence of shifts (Day, Night, Post-Night Rest, Vacation, Sick Leave, Standby).
- **Smart Shift Calendar:** Generates your working schedule for months into the future based on your first working day.

### 7.2. Logging Shifts, Night Multipliers & Overtime
- **Base Rate:** Supports hourly rate, fixed shift rate, or monthly base salary.
- **Night Work Premium (1.2x):** Legally mandated 20% or 40% surcharge for hours worked between 22:00 and 06:00.
- **Two-Tier Overtime:**
  - *Tier 1:* First 2 overtime hours paid at $1.5\times$ base rate.
  - *Tier 2:* Consecutive overtime hours paid at $2.0\times$ base rate.
- **Holiday Multiplier (2.0x):** Double pay for shifts falling on official public holidays.

### 7.3. Sick Leaves, Vacations & Business Trips
- **Sick Leave by Seniority:** Automatically adjusts sick pay percentage based on career longevity ($60\%$, $80\%$, or $100\%$).
- **Business Trips:** Automatically adds non-taxable daily subsistence allowances (Per Diem) and lodging/transportation reimbursements.

### 7.4. Gross-to-Net Payroll Calculation
Computes your net take-home salary after all deductions:
$$\text{Taxable Base} = \text{Gross Earnings} - \text{Tax Deductions}$$
$$\text{Income Tax} = \text{Taxable Base} \times \text{Tax Rate \%}$$
$$\text{Net Salary} = \text{Gross} + \text{Allowances} - \text{Taxes} - \text{Pension/Social} - \text{Advance Payments}$$

### 7.5. One-Click Earnings Synchronization to Budget
At the end of the pay cycle, click **"Sync to Finances"**. Novus Life creates an incoming income transaction in your target bank account, closing the loop between work hours and your personal budget!

---

## 8. Data Sync, Backups & Privacy

### 8.1. Local-First Offline Operation
- All operations save instantly to `IndexedDB` on your device.
- Even if offline for weeks, all calculations, graphs, and features operate at full capacity.

### 8.2. Cloud Synchronization
When connected to the internet:
- **Delta Sync:** Novus Life synchronizes only updated records (`updatedAt` timestamp comparisons) to minimize bandwidth.
- **Self-Hosted PostgreSQL & Supabase:** Connect to your private server with end-to-end Row Level Security (RLS). Each user can only read and write their own family data.

### 8.3. Google Drive Encrypted Vault Backup
- Authorize your Google account via OAuth 2.0.
- Novus Life creates an encrypted backup package inside the hidden `appDataFolder` in your personal Google Drive.
- Neither Google nor external third parties can read the contents without your master password.

---

## 9. Power User Tips & Shortcuts

- **Quick Action FAB (Floating Action Button):** The dynamic `+` button in the lower right adapts to the active tab:
  - In Utilities $\rightarrow$ Add Meter Reading.
  - In Finances $\rightarrow$ Add Expense or Income.
  - In Schedules $\rightarrow$ Log Completed Shift.
  - In Addresses $\rightarrow$ Add New Property.
- **Fast Date Shifting:** Click the month header on any screen to quickly pick another billing period without scrolling through tables.
- **Bulk Shift Assignment:** In the Schedule Calendar, switch to **"Batch Mode"** to select multiple days and assign shifts in one operation.
- **Exporting Raw Data:** Go to **Settings $\rightarrow$ Export Database** to download your complete workspace as a JSON archive.

---

## 10. Troubleshooting & FAQ

#### Q1: Will I lose my data if I clear my browser history?
**A:** Standard browser cache clearing usually preserves IndexedDB. However, selecting *"Delete all site cookies and offline data"* will erase local records. **Always enable Cloud Sync or export a JSON backup** before performing browser maintenance.

#### Q2: Can multiple family members share the same budget?
**A:** Yes! Under **Settings $\rightarrow$ Family Sharing**, create a Family Workspace. All invited accounts will see shared utility meters and pooled accounts while keeping personal debit cards private.

#### Q3: Why does OCR meter scanning give an incorrect number?
**A:** Check for glare on the glass dial or weak lighting. Turn on the built-in **Torch / Flashlight** toggle and hold your camera parallel to the meter dials. If dials are worn out, you can tap and edit any recognized digit before saving.

#### Q4: How do I switch languages?
**A:** Click your avatar or the Globe icon in the navigation bar. Novus Life supports English, Ukrainian, Polish, and Russian with instantaneous live switching without page reloads.

---

*End of User Manual. For technical architecture details, please refer to [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).*

# FULL MODULAR MASTER PLAN - AGENT CORE (CANONICAL SSoT)

Status: COMPLETED & LOCKED (Baseline v0.2.0, 2026-09-25)

Scope: agent-core only, with cross-repository boundary compliance to panel-core and installer.

Normative anchors:
- AGENTS.md
- ECOSYSTEM_MANIFEST.md

This file supersedes operational split planning as the authoritative master plan.
Working artifacts in docs/dev remain supporting records, not a parallel source of truth.

## 0. Mission, Scope, and Non-Negotiable Constraints

Mission:
- Evolve agent-core into an enterprise-grade, modular, security-first Go runtime
  while preserving platform compatibility and transport contracts.

Non-negotiable constraints:
- No breaking gRPC contract drift during migration.
- Security controls remain enforced end-to-end (TLS, signed metadata, replay, rate limit, audit).
- No business capability loss for telemetry, runtime operations, VFS, backup, PTY, WebSocket console, SSH/SFTP.
- Deterministic phase gates with reproducible validation.
- Installer and Panel interoperability preserved across releases.

## 0.1 Current Execution Snapshot (2026-09-25)

Execution status:
- Overall completion: 100.0% (35/35 checkpoints).
- Phase A (Contract Freeze and Reconciliation): 100% complete.
- Phase B (Composition Root and Module Skeleton): 100% complete.

  - internal/grpcserver/service.go (~556 LOC)

Validation baseline (latest run):
